# Quarterly Compliance Handbook

## Scope

This handbook applies to every vendor handling regulated customer data.

| Policy | Review cycle | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data retention | quarterly | compliance |
| Access audit | monthly | security |

## Vendor onboarding

- Collect the signed data-processing addendum before provisioning access
- Record the engagement in the vendor matrix within five business days

### Offboarding

Revoke all credentials on the termination date and archive the dossier.
